tools.name: check_shariah_compliance
tools.description: Check if a cryptocurrency is Halal or Haram under AAOIFI Shariah standards (No. 59 and No. 21). Returns compliance status, scholarly justification, category, and audit link.

ticker_or_name.description: The cryptocurrency symbol or name (e.g. BTC, Bitcoin, KAS, SOL, AAVE)

tools.name: get_halal_index_summary
tools.description: Get institutional statistics and methodology summary for the Halal Crypto Index (820 audited assets, AAOIFI standard, CERN Zenodo DOI).

tools.name: list_halal_coins
tools.description: List verified Halal cryptocurrencies filtered by optional category (e.g. Layer 1, Store of Value).

resources.name: AAOIFI Screening Methodology
resources.description: Comprehensive AAOIFI Shariah standard digital asset evaluation rules

resources.name: 820+ Audited Assets Dataset
resources.description: Complete dataset of 820+ audited digital assets with compliance statuses

prompts.name: audit_crypto_portfolio
prompts.description: Prompts the model to audit a list of cryptocurrency holdings against AAOIFI Shariah standards

arguments.name: holdings
arguments.description: Comma-separated list of cryptocurrency tickers (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, USDE, AAVE)
